title: C-owned Evaluation Split Lifecycle State
description: Current lifecycle state for one evaluation assignment, tracked on two INDEPENDENT axes — split_lock_status (whether this assignment's split placement is provisional or locked) and holdout_lifecycle_status (a separate axis that only matters once executed_split=HOLDOUT: has this HOLDOUT question ever actually been used as an independent final run). These are deliberately not merged into one enum: an assignment can be LOCKED_BY_CHAIN while its holdout_lifecycle_status is still SEALED (locked in place, but never yet run), and the two axes have different transition rules (see domain/runtime/evaluation-usage-ledger.mjs).

assigned_split.description: The split this assignment is authored/grouped for (domain/evaluation/README.md's group-then-assign rule), fixed independent of split_lock_status — a question is assigned to exactly one split from the moment its evaluation_group_id is formed, whether or not chain closure has locked it yet. An OFFICIAL (non-SANDBOX) execution is only permitted when executed_split equals this value — see canUseSplit in domain/runtime/evaluation-usage-ledger.mjs.

split_lock_status.description: Allowed forward transitions only: PROVISIONAL_UNTIL_CHAIN_CLOSURE -> LOCKED_BY_CHAIN, PROVISIONAL_UNTIL_CHAIN_CLOSURE -> LOCKED_BY_COVERAGE. Once locked, terminal — no transition out, in either direction, including between the two locked states.

holdout_lifecycle_status.description: Only meaningful once this assignment's split is HOLDOUT; a strictly linear forward chain: SEALED -> OPENED -> CONSUMED -> DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY. No backward transition and no skipping a stage (SEALED -> CONSUMED is rejected, as is CONSUMED -> OPENED).

last_usage_event_id.description: The usage event (see evaluation-usage-event.schema.json) that most recently drove a lifecycle transition for this assignment, or null if this assignment has never been used yet.
